request.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Input image is a style anchor only: the selected premium tactile Buki sketchpad concept. Do not simply recolor it. Reimagine the entire first screen for a modern children's drawing scrapbook while keeping its warm, dimensional paper-and-soft-rubber quality. Create a new composition with a compact playful wordmark at upper left, exact text "Buki", a curved garden-path brand line made from two subtle layered strokes, and a completely new abstract bloom mark made of five rounded pebble petals plus a tiny leaf. Center a large blank portrait drawing pad lower on the screen, with a refined top coil, generous dot-grid page, asymmetric corner protectors, and three functional-looking color tabs. Use a warm modern palette: apricot coral #FF765E, deep lagoon #167D82, butter #FFD65A, sky #6FA9E8, leaf #66A86B, oat #FFF5E5. Camera action is a small premium coral pebble button below the pad. Childlike and joyful but sophisticated, minimal, highly buildable in Expo/Skia. The page stays blank. Exact readable text only "Buki". No phone frame, no additional words, no giant mascot, no clutter, no photorealistic room.
